h1: The 5 Best Monitor Privacy Screen Protectors of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Monitor Privacy Protectors: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five monitor privacy screen protectors from infoWall, Magicmoon, Vxaop and more, compared on mounting, size and pack value.
summary: The infoWall 27 Inch 2-pack is our top choice because it attaches with a washable, tape-free nano-suction bezel and fits curved or flat monitors. The Magicmoon and Vxaop 24 inch pairs are the value picks, the Peslv is the removable option, and the SightPro adds anti-glare in a single filter.
intro: People searching for a screen protector often want something that clings to the glass. Privacy filters work differently, sitting over the monitor and narrowing the viewing angle, so the way a filter attaches matters more than the film itself.

We reviewed privacy filters for desktop monitors and ranked them on attachment, size coverage, pack count and price bucket. Laptop filters were left out. Four of the five are 24 inch, and one is 27 inch.

products.name: infoWall 2-Pack 27 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter, Nano-Suction Bezel
products.verdict: Tape-free, washable mounting that fits curved and flat 27 inch monitors.
products.description:
The infoWall is a 2-pack of 27 inch, 16:9 privacy filters with a nano-suction bezel. The listing says it works with both curved and flat monitors, and it is tape-free and washable. It sits in the $50 to $100 range.

The mounting is what separates it from the pack. Where other filters here do not describe attachment, this one explains it and avoids adhesive residue on your monitor.

It suits 27 inch owners, including curved screens. The caveat is that it is the only 27 inch protector here.

products.name: Peslv [2-Pack] 24 Inch Privacy Screen for Computer Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: A removable 24 inch pair with true side-angle privacy.
products.description:
The Peslv gives you two 24 inch widescreen filters offering true side-angle privacy, and it is removable. It lands in the $50 to $100 range.

It follows the infoWall because it gives you the pair and removability but not the described tape-free mount. Against the cheaper 24 inch pairs below, you pay more for the stated removable design.

It suits dual 24 inch desks. The caveat is the higher price tier.

products.name: Magicmoon 2-Pack 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 16:9 Monitor
products.verdict: A 24 inch pair at the lower price tier.
products.description:
The Magicmoon bundles two 24 inch widescreen filters with true side-angle privacy, priced in the $25 to $50 range.

The pair lands third because it drops into a cheaper bucket than the Peslv while listing the same size and privacy angle. The listing does not state whether it is removable, which is the gap.

It suits dual-monitor budgets. The caveat is the thin listing detail.
products.idealFor: Dual 24 inch monitors on a budget.
products.skipIf: You need to share your screen often.

products.name: Vxaop [2-Pack] 24 Inch Computer Privacy Screen Filter (16:9 Aspect Ratio)
products.verdict: A near-identical 24 inch pair from a lesser-known brand.
products.description:
The Vxaop also bundles two 24 inch widescreen filters with true side-angle privacy, in the $25 to $50 range.

It sits one place below the Magicmoon since the listed specs are the same and the brand is less established. There is no standout feature to separate them.

It suits buyers choosing on price. The caveat is that nothing here distinguishes it from the pair above.

products.name: SightPro 24 Inch 16:9 Computer Privacy Screen Filter for Monitor
products.verdict: A single 24 inch filter that adds anti-glare.
products.description:
The SightPro is a single 24 inch, 16:9 filter offering true side-angle privacy plus anti-glare, in the $25 to $50 range.

It finishes the list because you get one filter instead of two. Its anti-glare claim is the one extra none of the pairs list.

It suits single-monitor desks in bright rooms. The caveat is that you must buy a second for dual setups.

whatMatters.detail: Nano-suction clings without adhesive and can be washed. Adhesive tabs are more permanent. Check the listing for tape-free or removable wording.
A curved monitor needs a filter that flexes with it. Only the infoWall lists curved and flat support. Verify before ordering for a curved screen.
Filters are cut to a diagonal and a 16:9 ratio. A wrong size leaves gaps. Match the numbers in the title to your monitor.
Pairs cost less per screen. Count your monitors before choosing between a pair and a single.
Anti-glare cuts reflections in bright rooms. Only the SightPro lists it. Check for the word if your desk faces a window.

faq.q: Will it leave residue on my monitor?
faq.a: The infoWall is described as tape-free and washable. The other listings do not describe residue, so check the product page.
Buying on price without checking size. A 24 inch filter will not fit a 27 inch screen.

faq.q: Is the infoWall worth the extra over the 24 inch pairs?
faq.a: If you have a 27 inch or curved monitor, yes. If you have a 24 inch screen, it will not fit at all.

faq.q: How do I put one on?
faq.a: Follow the listing instructions. The infoWall uses a nano-suction bezel rather than adhesive tape.
The infoWall listing says it is washable. For the others, the listings do not say, so follow the maker's care notes.

faq.q: Do these work on a laptop?
faq.a: These are sized for desktop monitors. Laptop screens need a filter listed for your laptop size.

finalTake: The infoWall 2-Pack is the best monitor privacy protector for 27 inch and curved monitors. For 24 inch screens, the Peslv is the removable option, and the Magicmoon and Vxaop save money. Match the size first, then choose the mount.
